title: 滴眼药水：医生讲解与准备步骤示意

doctor.description: a Chinese female doctor with dark hair tied back, no glasses, wearing the existing white coat over a light-blue shirt, standing frontally in the bright consultation room beside the existing eye model and capped bottles

patient.description: the adult male demonstrator in the supplied bathroom reference, wearing the existing dark-grey rolled-sleeve shirt; preserve the visible crop, hands, sink, faucet and existing props

visual_constraints: Professional medical education. Preserve the supplied reference appearance and existing props. One continuous fixed-camera shot per clip. Do not add people, gloves, eye instruments, droplets or readable text. In voiceover shots, the demonstrator must not speak; all dialogue belongs to the same off-screen female narrator. No background music.

settings.tts_instruct: 标准普通话，清晰自然的女性医生科普讲解，语气专业亲切，语速自然偏利落，不拖长句尾。

shots.text: 今天讲解滴眼药水的方法，从用药前准备，到滴完后的处理，一起分步来看。
shots.action: The doctor explains calmly to camera with relaxed hands and natural blinking. Do not handle the bottles or eye model.

shots.text: 先核对药名、要滴哪只眼和有效期；开封后的使用期限，按说明书确认。
shots.action: Continue from the preceding pose with relaxed hands and subtle facial movement. Do not pick up any props.

shots.text: 用肥皂和清水洗手。这里展示洗手的一部分，实际操作要把双手洗干净。
shots.action: Close-up of the existing soapy hands at the running faucet. Make only gentle rubbing movements, keeping hands, faucet and water flow consistent. No face needs to enter the frame. This is a brief excerpt, not a complete handwashing sequence.

shots.text: 按说明书确认是否需要摇匀。开盖后别碰瓶口，也别让瓶口接触其他物体。
shots.action: Hold the already-open white bottle upright in the existing hand, away from the face. Keep the cap on the existing tissue. Only tiny natural hand movements; do not open, shake or invert the bottle and do not touch its tip.

shots.text: 坐稳后，头稍后仰，眼睛向上看；轻拉下眼睑，形成一个小口袋。
shots.action: The doctor verbally explains the step while looking at camera, with hands relaxed. Do not mime pulling an eyelid or tilt the head back. No procedure is performed in this shot.

shots.text: 另一只手把药瓶倒置，瓶口悬在小口袋上方，别碰眼睛、眼睑或睫毛。
shots.action: Continue the explanation from the previous final pose. Keep hands relaxed and all desk props untouched. Do not perform or mime instillation.

shots.text: 按医嘱，把规定的滴数滴进小口袋。不要为了增加效果，自行多滴。
shots.action: Continue speaking in the existing pose with small natural facial movements only. Do not pick up a bottle, touch the eye or demonstrate droplets.

shots.text: 滴完轻轻闭眼，用手指轻按靠鼻侧的内眼角至少一分钟，不要按压眼球。
shots.action: The doctor explains this aftercare step verbally, maintaining camera eye contact and relaxed hands. Do not demonstrate eye closure or move a finger toward the eye.

shots.text: 同一只眼使用不同眼药水，至少间隔五分钟。具体滴数、次数和顺序，遵医嘱。
shots.action: Finish the explanation naturally from the preceding pose, keeping hands relaxed. A single slight nod may occur after the final words.
shots.keypoint: 不同眼药水至少间隔五分钟
